Round 2 assignment: program_ext_termination_fee takes 5 factors, program_ext_shortfall_late_charge 6, program_ext_return_late_charge 6.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Task 0 holds program_ext_sla_claim_credit and program_ext_worker_fee_rerate. This task holds program_ext_termination_fee (program_termination_notice + its early_termination_fee line, sign_termination_notice_c67c1163, owner=user), program_ext_shortfall_late_charge and program_ext_return_late_charge (program_late_charge, assess_shortfall_late_charge_82f1f096 / assess_return_late_charge_9954ff84). Disjoint; together all five policies are covered. program_amend stays unusable (its authorized_role gate binds a one-field group with mixed authority, which check_solvability cannot pass).
WHY A GOOD TEST. The caller only wants to give notice and know the fee. The fee needs the notice-period arithmetic, a monthly charge whose make-up depends on the fee model, the payroll card bundle, and three record-driven multipliers. Before the fee is billed and the notice recorded the rule waits on the late charge of the schedule the latest return reinstated, and that late charge waits on the late charge of the latest employer-liable shortfall notice (its rate counts late charges already booked); each wait names exactly the item its resolver prices. Each late charge is a six-factor computation over the settlement and billing ledgers and the Payroll Card funding ledger. Difficulty: reading three rules and their two prerequisite sentences, rebuilding the open amounts of both overdue items, counting returns across two programs, and booking in the one admissible order.

DESIGN THESIS. 'give notice, what is the fee' -> fee rule: billed (notice recorded) only after the schedule named by the only return of the latest return day carries its late charge -> return late charge rule: fixed only after the latest employer-liable notice in the shortfall rule's scope carries its late charge -> book 362.06 on notice a0488981-6e39-4075-9470-d76e9b71b76a -> book 1659.45 on schedule 92ab57d3-faf0-4aed-a0e6-50e3088bdb87 -> notice signed with fee 25115.65. Depth 2 hops; breadth: settlements (109 rows), billing (130 rows), censuses (21), Payroll Card holding and funding ledger (126 rows), absent Instant Pay.
FACTOR CARD program_ext_shortfall_late_charge (charge_amount, state_due; baseline greater of 75.00 and 12480.90 x 1.25% = 156.01): culpability_method (method: deducted_not_remitted -> minimum plus percentage; payroll error / deduction not taken -> percentage alone; else greater-of -> 287.06 at baseline), liable_frequency (2 liable notices in 12 months -> +0.25 -> 330.86; near-miss: four provider-absorbed notices are not counted), notice_days_past_due (12 days -> +0.25 -> 330.86), notice_overdue_balance (12480.90 -> +0.10 -> 349.58), notice_concurrent_delinquency (the schedule of the only return of 2026-10-09 still open 46018.72 -> +0.20 -> 337.10), notice_prior_charges (the 2026-07-13 late charge -> +0.25 -> 330.86). Expected 362.06.
FACTOR CARD program_ext_return_late_charge (charge_amount, state_due; baseline greater of 75.00 and 46018.72 x 1.25% = 575.23): returned_payments_method (method, cross-difficulty paycard: two remittance returns plus the 2026-08-21 Payroll Card funding return = 3 -> minimum plus the rate on the whole returned 66018.72 -> 1104.45 at baseline; near-miss: a funding return older than 12 months would not count), return_days_past_due (13 days -> +0.25 -> 1494.40), return_overdue_balance (46018.72 -> +0.15 -> 1560.42), return_concurrent_delinquency (the latest liable notice's schedule still open 12480.90 -> +0.10 -> 1593.43), return_prior_charges (2 late charges, the July one and step 10 -> +0.50 -> 1329.36; value_input), return_liable_history (2 liable notices -> +0.15 -> 1560.42). Expected 1659.45. Near-miss: the February return was re-sent in full before its grace ended and carries no late charge.
FACTOR CARD program_ext_termination_fee (early_termination_fee, on_request; baseline 6 x 2950.00 = 17700.00): termination_fee_lines (method: employer_sponsored -> adds the July-September sponsored lines / 3 = 6433.9967 -> 6740.16 at baseline; near-miss: the June lines entered 2026-07-03 are 3 whole months old), termination_bundle (cross paycard, multi-source launch AND package: Advantage -> 20 percent -> 26800.69), contract_year (23 whole months -> x0.7 -> 35879.51), breach_relief (one SLA credit in 6 months -> x0.8 -> 31394.57; the 2026-01-08 credit is outside), workforce_reduction (12.57 percent -> x0.85 -> 29547.83). Expected 25115.65.
Realism (F1 and the coordinator's list): late charges on a monthly rate with a minimum, stepped up by days past due, by the overdue balance, by a second delinquency open at the same time (only amounts past due count), by repeat delinquency (late charges, employer-liable shortfalls, returned payments across Paystride programs) and by culpability (money deducted and kept bears the minimum on top of the percentage; honest payroll errors bear the percentage alone). The early termination fee recovers the remaining committed fees actually billed (platform fee after the card bundle plus the sponsored transfer fees), declining by contract year and relieved for SLA breaches and a reduction in force. Values are Paystride's own schedule (extended params).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. program_late_charge (steps 10, 12): program_evt_late_charge grace (time; notice a0488981-6e39-4075-9470-d76e9b71b76a due 2026-10-08 -> grace ends 2026-10-16; schedule 92ab57d3-faf0-4aed-a0e6-50e3088bdb87 due 2026-10-07 (a returned remittance runs from the original due date) -> 2026-10-15; counted from the day after the due date, 2026-10-12 a Federal Reserve holiday; inclusive) and one_per_period (no late charge points to either item). program_termination_notice (step 14): program_lifecycle notice_from_live (live). The requester rule is met by the program owner. Suspension is not owed: the oldest past-due item (due 2026-09-23) is 27 days past due, below 30. Overwrites: both late-charge policies retire the base amount clause with sibling tails that restate the base for every overdue item except the two each selects and name both; the shortfall policy also retires the overdue-item sentence (a schedule with an employer-liable notice is charged through the notice). The fee policy retires the final-invoice ETF clause (restated for other notices) and the bundle sentence as a sibling of the two task-0 policies.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Shortfall charge: notice a0488981-6e39-4075-9470-d76e9b71b76a; open = schedule 5b4096e6-8c76-46af-b3dc-3f7c37e7f411: 71205.33 - 53517.58 - 4000.00 - 1206.85 = 12480.90. Return charge: schedule 92ab57d3-faf0-4aed-a0e6-50e3088bdb87; open 66018.72 - 66018.72 + 66018.72 - 20000.00 = 46018.72; returned amount 66018.72 (return f38aa769-57e9-4a7d-828f-a911450cd373). Concurrent items: each late charge reads the other overdue item's open amount (46018.72 for the shortfall charge, 12480.90 for the return charge); the not-yet-due 2026-10-16 schedule (71921.98) enters neither. Fee: the agreement; a new early_termination_fee line for 2026-10.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root program_ext_termination_fee (owner user). Edge 1 -> program_ext_return_late_charge, kind state_gate (gate program_billing.related_entry_id), form state: 'The early termination fee is billed, and the termination notice recorded with it, only after, where the remittance return booked most recently is the only remittance return booked that day and the deduction schedule it names carries no employer-liable shortfall notice, that schedule carries the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in once its late-charge grace has passed.' Edge 2 program_ext_return_late_charge -> program_ext_shortfall_late_charge, value_input (gate prior_count), form state: 'A late charge on a deduction schedule reinstated by a returned remittance is fixed only after, where the employer-liable shortfall notice booked most recently is the only employer-liable notice booked that day and the only one on the deduction schedule it concerns, that schedule carries no remittance return, and the notice has an open amount of at least the de minimis amount, that notice carries the late charge owed for the late-charge period it is in once its late-charge grace has passed.' Four-point test: 'only after'; record-visible state (a late charge pointing to the named item); no tool/id/code token; each sentence is engaged only inside its resolver's own scope test (the single item of its day; for the return, a schedule with no liable notice; for the notice, the only liable notice on its schedule, a schedule with no return, and an open amount of at least the de minimis threshold). E3 tests, edge 1: engaged and unmet at the opening (the only return of 2026-10-09 names 92ab57d3-faf0-4aed-a0e6-50e3088bdb87, no liable notice on it, grace passed 2026-10-15, 46018.72 open, no late charge points to it) and satisfiable by its resolver in every engaged world (inside that scope the return policy prices that schedule; nothing owed means nothing waited on; outside the scope, including a schedule carrying both a return and a liable notice, nothing is waited on). Edge 2: engaged and unmet (the only liable notice of 2026-09-24 is a0488981-6e39-4075-9470-d76e9b71b76a, alone on 5b4096e6-8c76-46af-b3dc-3f7c37e7f411, no return on that schedule, grace passed 2026-10-16, no late charge) and satisfiable in every engaged world (inside that scope the shortfall policy prices exactly that notice). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a late charge on that schedule and on that notice. Order 10 -> 12 -> 14. Deletion: skip step 10 -> return charge 1494.40; skip step 12 -> the fee would be billed while its wait is false and the terminal state lacks both late charges (state_gate). user_scenario mentions no charge kind; tools validate nothing.
PERSONA DESIGN. Marcus Ashby, COO and program owner; volunteers only the notice and the fee question and that he signs himself; identity only when asked; acknowledges late payments only after the agent says charges must be booked; his line reads 'If the agent tells you that some charges have to be booked on the account before your notice can be recorded, you say you know finance is behind on a couple of payments' and names no kind of charge; keeps the payroll card program if asked; signs with exactly the quoted figures and ends on the confirmation.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify -> agreement -> settlements -> billing -> census -> paycard -> paycard funding -> Instant Pay (none) -> unlock/call assess_shortfall_late_charge (notice, 362.06, 2026-12-04) -> unlock/call assess_return_late_charge (schedule, 1659.45, 2026-12-04) -> hand over sign_termination_notice (agreement, 25115.65, 2026-12-04).
TRAPS. user_scenario:
You are Marcus Ashby, chief operating officer of Cardinal Ridge Home Health, Inc., a home care agency based on Chicago's Northwest Side with a few thousand caregivers. You are the program owner on the company's Paystride earned wage access agreement. The company is cutting back on vendor programs after a hard year, and the leadership team has decided to end the earned wage access program. You are calling to give the company's written termination notice today, taking effect as early as the agreement allows, and you want to know what the early termination fee comes to. You know the notice has to be signed by you as the program owner, so you will sign and submit it yourself on this call once you have the figure; you do not want anyone at Paystride to submit it for you. Your manner is calm, a little weary and very matter-of-fact; you have had a long week and you want to get this done properly.

When the agent asks how to find the account, you give your direct line, 3125550177. To confirm who you are you give the last four digits of the company's EIN, 1593, and, only if another detail is needed, the billing ZIP code 60631. If asked your role, you are the program owner. If asked when the termination should take effect, you say as early as the agreement allows; you have no particular date in mind. If asked about the payroll card program, you say the company is keeping it; only the earned wage access agreement is ending. You do not know any fee, balance or charge amounts and you never offer a figure.

If the agent tells you that some charges have to be booked on the account before your notice can be recorded, you say you know finance is behind on a couple of payments and that the agent should book whatever the agreement requires. When the agent quotes the early termination fee and gives you the notice to sign, you sign it using exactly the agreement reference, fee and due date the agent gave you, and you read back the confirmation you receive. If the agent offers to submit the notice for you, you decline and sign it yourself. Once the notice is recorded and you have the confirmation, you thank the agent and end the call without asking for anything else.
